title: Your own workers
subtitle: Run agents on compute you own.
empty: No workers yet. Runs use the shared worker.

default.label: New evaluations run on
default.hint: Each evaluation can pick another worker.

actions.confirmRemove: Remove the worker {{name}}? Runs stop going to it; its token stops working.

form.title: Connect a worker
form.name: Name
form.nameHint: Letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-'. Evaluations use this name.
form.secretHint: Encrypted. Used only to start and stop this worker.
form.vmHint: Run our command on Ubuntu or Debian with Docker and 20 GB free. It installs as a service.
form.installHint: Holds this worker's token. Copy it now, keep it private. Admins can show it again.
form.startHint: Start it to use it. First start installs, taking a few minutes.

runloop.blueprintHint: A blueprint with Docker preinstalled starts faster.

fly.appHint: An app you created for workers: fly apps create <name>

runpod.gpuTypeHint: A RunPod GPU id, for example NVIDIA L4 (default) or NVIDIA H100 PCIe.
runpod.imageHint: Needs Docker for agent containers. The default CUDA image installs it if allowed.

kubernetes.manifestHint: Creates a narrow Heimdall account. The worker changes only its own run namespaces.
kubernetes.kubeconfigHint: Inline certificates and tokens only. A kubeconfig that runs a login plugin is refused.
kubernetes.imageHint: Needs heimdall and your project. Empty uses the server's image.

target.label: Runs go to
target.hint: Applies to every run in the organization. An evaluation can still pick one of your workers.
target.error: Could not change where runs go
target.loadError: Could not load where runs go
target.notForOne: set it as where runs go on the Workers page
target.onlyOneSlots: Runs on: {{label}}. It runs {{n}} at a time.
target.askAdmin: An admin can add a worker on the Workers page.

shared.hostCap: Shared worker runs {{n}} at a time across all organizations.
shared.noRemove: Provided by this server. Cannot be removed.
